test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The US has become far more ______ to people with all kinds of food sensitivities and diet regimens.
solution: The correct answer is '**accommodating**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**accommodating**'. • In the given context it means the US is 'eager or willing to give what is needed to someone'. • *Example: The airline could not have been more **accommodating** (= willing to help) in getting me on a connecting flight.* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **deviated**: to change or become different from what is normal or expected. (सामान्‍य या प्रत्याशित व्‍यवहार को बदलना या उससे हट कर आचरण करना, लीक से हटना या हटाना, उपयुक्त व्‍यवहार से हटना) • **lodging**: a place where you can stay. (ठहरने का स्‍थान, अस्‍थायी आवास) • **selective**: careful when choosing. (चयन करने में सावधान; चयनशील) • Thus, as per the above explanations, we find that the correct answer is** Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__*** The US has become far more **accommodating** to people with all kinds of food sensitivities and diet regimens.* 43:T76b, The erroneous part is '**Frank has being making**'.
